examples: Mosquitoes can transmit several dangerous diseases to humans.
پشه‌ها می‌توانند چند بیماری خطرناک را به انسان‌ها منتقل کنند.
The radio station will transmit the game live across the country.
ایستگاه رادیویی بازی را به‌صورت زنده در سراسر کشور پخش خواهد کرد.
Parents often transmit their values and habits to their children without realizing it.
والدین اغلب بدون اینکه متوجه باشند، ارزش‌ها و عادات خود را به فرزندانشان منتقل می‌کنند.
miniContext: To transmit something means to send or pass it from one place, person, or generation to another. Signals from satellites transmit television and phone data across vast distances in seconds. Diseases can also transmit from person to person through close contact, which is why hygiene matters so much during an outbreak.

examples: Could you please confirm your appointment for tomorrow morning?
می‌شود لطفاً قرار ملاقات خود را برای فردا صبح تأیید کنید؟
The lab results confirm that the treatment is working well.
نتایج آزمایشگاه تأیید می‌کند که درمان به‌خوبی جواب می‌دهد.
We need to confirm the flight details before we leave for the airport.
باید جزئیات پرواز را قبل از رفتن به فرودگاه تأیید کنیم.
miniContext: To confirm something means to state or show that it is true, certain, or definite. Before a big event, organizers usually confirm the guest list and schedule with everyone involved. Scientists repeat experiments many times to confirm that their results are reliable rather than due to chance.

examples: We had to take a detour because the main road was closed for repairs.
مجبور شدیم مسیر انحرافی را برویم چون خیابان اصلی برای تعمیرات بسته بود.
The construction crew set up signs directing drivers to a detour around the bridge.
گروه ساخت‌وساز تابلوهایی نصب کرد که رانندگان را به مسیر انحرافی اطراف پل هدایت می‌کرد.
Life rarely goes in a straight line; sometimes you need an unexpected detour to find the right path.
زندگی به‌ندرت در یک مسیر مستقیم پیش می‌رود؛ گاهی به یک مسیر انحرافی غیرمنتظره نیاز داری تا راه درست را پیدا کنی.
miniContext: A detour is an alternative route taken when the usual path is blocked or unavailable. Road crews often set up a detour during construction so traffic can still reach its destination. People also use the word figuratively to describe an unplanned change of direction in life or in a plan.

examples: After the long shift, the nurses looked weary but satisfied.
بعد از آن شیفت طولانی، پرستاران خسته اما راضی به نظر می‌رسیدند.
Travelers are often weary by the time they reach the hotel after a twelve-hour flight.
مسافران معمولاً تا زمانی که بعد از پرواز دوازده‌ساعته به هتل می‌رسند خسته هستند.
Voters grew weary of empty campaign promises.
رأی‌دهندگان از وعده‌های انتخاباتی پوچ خسته و بی‌حوصله شدند.
miniContext: Being weary means feeling very tired, either physically or mentally, often after prolonged effort. Soldiers returning from a long march are usually weary and need rest before anything else. The public can also grow weary of a topic that is repeated too often in the news.

examples: The scholarship is awarded purely on academic merit, not family income.
این بورسیه کاملاً بر اساس شایستگی علمی اعطا می‌شود، نه درآمد خانواده.
Her argument has some merit, even if I disagree with her conclusion.
استدلال او تا حدی ارزش دارد، حتی اگر با نتیجه‌گیری‌اش موافق نباشم.
Employees should be promoted based on merit rather than personal connections.
کارمندان باید بر اساس شایستگی ارتقا پیدا کنند، نه روابط شخصی.
miniContext: Merit refers to the quality of being good, deserving, or worthy of praise, often based on ability or achievement. A merit-based system rewards people for their skills and effort rather than their background or connections. When evaluating an argument, it helps to consider its merit honestly, separate from personal feelings about the speaker.

examples: The charity issued an urgent plea for donations after the flood.
آن خیریه بعد از سیل، درخواست فوری برای کمک‌های مالی صادر کرد.
He made a tearful plea for forgiveness in front of the whole family.
او با گریه در برابر تمام خانواده التماس بخشش کرد.
The defendant entered a plea of not guilty at the hearing.
متهم در جلسه دادگاه، اعلام بی‌گناهی خود را ثبت کرد.
miniContext: A plea is an emotional or urgent request, often made when someone badly needs help or mercy. After the earthquake, aid organizations sent out a plea for volunteers and supplies. In a courtroom, the word has a specific legal meaning too, referring to a formal statement of guilt or innocence.

examples: The two cars nearly collide at that corner every single day.
آن دو خودرو تقریباً هر روز در آن گوشه خیابان با هم برخورد می‌کنند.
Scientists study how particles collide inside the accelerator to understand matter.
دانشمندان بررسی می‌کنند که ذرات چگونه درون شتاب‌دهنده با هم برخورد می‌کنند تا ماده را بهتر بشناسند.
Their opposing opinions were bound to collide during the meeting.
نظرات متضاد آن‌ها قرار بود در آن جلسه با هم تصادم پیدا کند.
miniContext: To collide means to crash violently into something else, whether physically or figuratively. Two asteroids can collide in space and break into thousands of smaller fragments. People's interests sometimes collide too, as when two coworkers disagree strongly about how a project should be run.

examples: This medicine should relieve your headache within thirty minutes.
این دارو باید سردردت را در عرض سی دقیقه تسکین بدهد.
Talking to a friend can relieve a lot of stress after a hard day.
صحبت کردن با یک دوست می‌تواند استرس زیادی را بعد از یک روز سخت کم کند.
The news that everyone was safe relieved the worried families.
خبر اینکه همه سالم هستند، خانواده‌های نگران را آرام کرد.
miniContext: To relieve someone means to reduce their pain, worry, or pressure in some way. A warm bath can relieve sore muscles after a difficult workout. Good news can also relieve anxiety instantly, as when a doctor tells a patient that a test result turned out to be normal.

examples: She faced a difficult dilemma: accept the job abroad or stay close to her aging parents.
او با دوراهی دشواری روبه‌رو شد: پذیرفتن شغل در خارج یا ماندن نزدیک والدین سالخورده‌اش.
The doctor explained the dilemma of choosing between two risky treatments.
دکتر دوراهی انتخاب میان دو درمان پرخطر را توضیح داد.
Every manager eventually faces the dilemma of firing a hardworking but underperforming employee.
هر مدیری دیر یا زود با دوراهی اخراج یک کارمند زحمتکش اما ضعیف در عملکرد روبه‌رو می‌شود.
miniContext: A dilemma is a situation requiring a choice between two options that are both difficult or unpleasant in some way. Ethical dilemmas often appear in medicine, where doctors must balance a patient's wishes against medical best practice. Resolving a dilemma usually means accepting that no choice will be entirely free of drawbacks.

examples: Before publishing the article, the editor asked the reporter to verify every fact.
قبل از انتشار مقاله، سردبیر از خبرنگار خواست همه حقایق را راستی‌آزمایی کند.
You can verify your identity online by uploading a photo of your passport.
می‌توانی هویت خود را به‌صورت آنلاین با بارگذاری عکس گذرنامه راستی‌آزمایی کنی.
Scientists repeated the experiment several times to verify the surprising results.
دانشمندان آزمایش را چند بار تکرار کردند تا نتایج شگفت‌انگیز را تأیید کنند.
miniContext: To verify something means to check carefully that it is true, accurate, or genuine. Banks often verify a customer's income before approving a large loan. Journalists have a professional duty to verify their sources rather than simply repeating unconfirmed rumors.

examples: The strange noise coming from the engine continued to baffle the mechanics.
آن صدای عجیب از موتور همچنان تعمیرکاران را سردرگم می‌کرد.
Her sudden decision to quit the job baffled all of her coworkers.
تصمیم ناگهانی او برای ترک شغل همه همکارانش را سردرگم کرد.
The ancient symbols on the wall still baffle archaeologists today.
نمادهای باستانی روی دیوار هنوز هم باستان‌شناسان را سردرگم می‌کند.
miniContext: To baffle someone means to confuse them so completely that they cannot find an explanation. Magic tricks are designed to baffle the audience by hiding how the illusion actually works. Doctors are sometimes baffled by rare symptoms that do not match any known disease.

examples: Analysts anticipate a sharp rise in prices next year.
تحلیلگران افزایش شدید قیمت‌ها را برای سال آینده پیش‌بینی می‌کنند.
We should anticipate heavy traffic if we leave during rush hour.
اگر در ساعت ترافیک حرکت کنیم، باید انتظار ترافیک سنگین را داشته باشیم.
A good host tries to anticipate her guests' needs before they even ask.
یک میزبان خوب سعی می‌کند نیازهای مهمانانش را حتی قبل از درخواست پیش‌بینی کند.
miniContext: To anticipate something means to expect it in advance and often prepare for it. Experienced chess players anticipate their opponent's next several moves before making their own. Businesses that anticipate changes in customer demand are usually better positioned to succeed than those that simply react after the fact.
